argv: turn Walkability on over ground built around cars on Explore
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** turn Walkability on over ground built around cars on Explore's map and on a walk's map, and zoom in and out slowly through a whole zoom level. **Expect:** the car ground draws as the slate hatch (`<Images>` with `assets/map/walk-hatch-<q>.png` at the phone's scale, one image a quarter zoom, `fill-pattern` switched as each move settles, no antialiasing) with its 1 px slate edge, the lines about 9 to 11 px apart and crisp at every zoom, under the base map's labels (`beforeId={WALK_BELOW}`), the streets and labels readable through it; ground easy on foot is the plain map. (CG1, CG2, CG10)

argv: with the layer on, navigate a route into ground built around cars
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** with the layer on, navigate a route into ground built around cars, then switch the layer off and on, then End. **Expect:** the route's stretch through the hatch wears a slate casing between the white edge and the blue line (`route-car`, `beforeId="route"`, cut square), beginning and ending at the hatch's edge, a small slate dot ringed in white where it begins (`route-car-start`); gone with the layer off and at End. (CG6, CG11)
